Train Speed Quadratic: Class 10 board exam ka classic word problem, step by step, with the negative-root trap that costs marks.

• Let speed = x km/h, so 360/x - 360/(x + 5) = 1
• LCM and cross multiply: x² + 5x - 1800 = 0
• Factorise: (x + 45)(x - 40) = 0, so x = 40 or -45
• The trap: speed can't be negative, so reject -45
• Speed = 40 km/h (check: 9 h - 8 h = 1 h)
